title: Relevance Propagation as Entropic Optimal Transport on Filippov Neural Networks: Sinkhorn Propagation and Region Relevance in Image Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2611.05594v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relevance propagation, which redistributes a network's prediction backward through the layers, is usually treated as a heuristic. We show that it is the solution of a single variational problem: Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) is the divergence-free flow on the active computational graph of zero relative entropy to the backward transition law of the forward activation flow; for a non-negative reference, this is a relative entropy between Markov measures on backward paths. The rules LRP$_0$, LRP$_{z^+}$ and LRP$_{\alpha,\beta}$ follow from this principle by the choice of a reference, and are instances of one rule, LRPN$_{\alpha,\beta}$, whose weights may vary from node to node, for instance with the node's activity, in the spirit of Hebb's principle. The principle rests on a measure-theoretic formalization of feed-forward networks as directed acyclic graphs of Filippov operators, which covers piecewise-smooth and discontinuous arch

translated_title: 相关性传播作为Filippov神经网络上的熵最优传输：图像分类器中的Sinkhorn传播与区域相关性
translated_abstract: 相关性传播将网络的预测结果逐层向后重新分配，通常被视为一种启发式方法。我们证明它实际上是某一单一变分问题的解：分层相关性传播（LRP）是激活计算图上的无发散流，其相对于前向激活流的后向转移律具有零相对熵；对于非负参考，这对应于后向路径上马尔可夫测度之间的相对熵。LRP₀、LRP$_{z^+}$和LRP$_{α,β}$等规则通过选择参考而由此原理导出，且都是单一规则LRPN$_{α,β}$的实例，该规则的权重可随节点而变化（例如随节点的活动而变化），这体现了Hebb原理的精神。该原理建立在前馈网络作为Filippov算子构成的有向无环图的测度论形式化基础之上，涵盖了分段光滑和不连续的网络架构……
tldr: 该论文证明神经网络中的相关性传播（LRP）本质上是熵最优传输变分问题的解，通过将前馈网络形式化为Filippov算子的有向无环图，统一了各种LRP规则并提出了权重可随节点活动变化的LRPN规则。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that relevance propagation (LRP) in neural networks is the solution of a single entropic optimal transport variational problem, unifying various LRP rules by formalizing feed-forward networks as directed acyclic graphs of Filippov operators and proposing the LRPN rule whose weights can vary with node activity in the spirit of Hebb's principle.
